implemented_scope.runtime_write_boundary: explicit prepare only; getter never backfills SQLite or CAS
implemented_scope.persistence: immutable canonical JSON sidecar in Runtime CAS plus compact SQLite candidate/node link
implemented_scope.persistence_commit: SQLite Link insertion or idempotent reuse and CAS reachability promotion occur in one transaction; CAS bytes are staged first because filesystem CAS and SQLite are not a cross-medium transaction
implemented_scope.failed_commit_rollback: on Link commit failure, Runtime may remove only the current put call's created_new temporary sidecar after proving it is unlinked; cloned Store handles serialize CAS put attribution, and pre-existing, peer-created, linked or reachable CAS objects are never deleted
implemented_scope.idempotency: candidate_id + subdivision_node_id unique; identical request_sha256 returns the same link; any drift fails closed

binding_and_integrity.prepare_prerequisite: existing read-only projection must pass durable evidence validation, strict GLB inspection and fixed-Worker full-GLB byte replay
binding_and_integrity.readback: restart-safe CAS read with canonical-byte, schema, candidate, artifact, evidence and ArtifactReadback revalidation
binding_and_integrity.mcp_wire_budget: complete Link@1 response at or below 1 MiB; no truncation

research_boundary.adoption_mode: clean-room typed Rust adaptation; upstream source remains reference-only
research_boundary.license_result: no Blender GPL or OpenSubdiv source copied into Runtime

limitations: Filesystem CAS staging and SQLite are not claimed as one cross-medium atomic transaction; the durable reviewable boundary is the SQLite Link plus reachability transaction, with bounded rollback for a newly created unlinked temporary sidecar and general GC deferred to MCP011.
The sidecar persists current candidate-local lineage; it does not create cross-version element identity.
It exposes source-primitive-local triangle ranges, not glTF vertex, edge or corner identity.
It remains limited to regular rectangular open subd-cage@2 grids and integer crease levels 1 to 2.
Persistence and exact replay are structural evidence and do not prove likeness, Cycles or EEVEE parity, PBR quality, human acceptance or 360-degree quality.
